address: 241-243 Nguyen Trai Street, Nguyen Cu Trinh Ward, District 1, Ho Chi Minh City, 71014, Vietnam
bio: This venue may not offer much in terms of ambience, but can’t be beaten for tasty beef noodles at affordable prices. Besides the usual raw beef, or medium-rare brisket, their springy and flavoursome beef balls are also a must. If you can’t make up your mind, order the house special with everything in the bowl. Basil, bean sprouts, onion and lime wedges are served on the side. Feel free to customise your phở according to your whim....
